title: I keep Dying in Another World
description:
Engaging and gripping story from beginning to end, twists, turns, and despair await!WHAT!? I'VE BEEN ISEKAI'D!?What if one day you suddenly get summoned to Another World without explanation and... die just around the corner? What if after that, a suspicious Goddess tells you that you must do something... but she's so vague to not even explain what?

In this Kinetic Novel, follow John Smith, a regular junior programmer struggling with self-confidence, as he tries to stop a murder from happening. He will keep returning after death to continue with newfound knowledge, alliances, and ideas to fulfill the mission the Goddess tasked him with. As many times as it takes.COMPLEX, SERIOUS, LINEAR STORYWhat secrets is the Goddess hiding? Will she be a help or a hindrance?
Uncover the conspiracy behind the murder.
There are clues scattered on the way. Can YOU unravel the mystery before John does?FANTASY WORLDWith a carefully designed story, characters, and world, dive into this anime-inspired tale!KEY FEATURES:- countless deaths - roughly 4 hours of story, depending on your reading speed
- cinematic experience - immerse yourself at your own pace with intriguing and captivating story beats!
- dark comedy, romance, thriller, and psychological horror all in one package!
description_short: Fantasy Murder Mystery Visual Novel filled with dark humor, countless deaths, despair, suspenseful twists, and complex relationships in an exciting story!
